title: Dutch Forts in Sri Lanka banner exhibition
scope: VOC fort system and site-specific banners
limitations: curated public synthesis; rhetorical compression; quantify/causalize only with T0/T1 corroboration

title: Slavery in Pre-colonial Sri Lanka; What the literature reveals
scope: precolonial slavery/bondage overview
limitations: author explicitly describes a limited literature survey

title: Tracing bonded lives: Stories of enslaved individuals from the archive
scope: VOC Colombo slavery through archival cases
limitations: public-facing synthesis of a researcher’s archival work; follow underlying scholarship for closure

title: A Footnote in History: the life of Willem de Melho
scope: Tamil translators, Christian seminary, Sri Lanka–Netherlands mobility
limitations: microhistory/public history; individual life cannot stand for all intermediaries

title: Classifications at Work: Social Categories and Dutch Bureaucracy in Colonial Sri Lanka
scope: VOC bureaucracy, categories, thombos, taxation and local hierarchy
limitations: focuses especially on the eighteenth-century coastal bureaucracy; do not generalize uniformly across all periods/provinces

title: Lawmaking in Dutch Sri Lanka
scope: VOC law, territorial government, land rights and Kandy relations
limitations: legal-administrative lens

title: The Ambivalence of Freedom: Slaves in Jaffna, Sri Lanka, in the Eighteenth and Nineteenth Centuries
scope: Dutch/British slavery, caste and codification in Jaffna
limitations: Jaffna-specific; does not describe all labour regimes on the island

title: The Indian Dimension in the War of the Austrian Succession, 1744–48
scope: opening phase of the long Anglo-French struggle for political influence in India
limitations: India-centred; effects on Ceylon are an indirect regional bridge

title: The Struggle for Supremacy in the Carnatic during the Seven Years War, 1756–61
scope: Anglo-French military struggle and collapse of French territorial challenge in South India
limitations: Carnatic focus; do not equate French military defeat with disappearance of French trade

title: The French Presence in India between 1754 and 1815
scope: French territorial contraction after 1761/1763 and continued commercial presence to 1815
limitations: French-India lens; distinguish comptoir survival from strategic parity

title: Holding on in India: The Late Seventeenth and Eighteenth Centuries
scope: Portuguese Estado da Índia after seventeenth-century losses
limitations: supports long decline/reconfiguration, not a single-war collapse thesis

title: Decline and stagnation — The Portuguese in India
scope: historiography and chronology of Portuguese decline
limitations: older synthesis; useful especially to reject teleological British accounts

title: The Company Fortress — Conclusion
scope: 1795 Cochin, 1796 Ceylon, Amiens and end of Dutch military presence in South Asia
limitations: fort/company focus; pair with wider Napoleonic Indian Ocean work

title: The Anglo-Dutch Imperial Meridian in the Indian Ocean World, 1795–1820
scope: British capture of Dutch Indian Ocean colonies and transfer of administrative knowledge
limitations: doctoral thesis; broad Indian Ocean comparison

title: British Naval Power in the East, 1794–1805 — Introduction
scope: British naval supremacy after Seven Years War and strategic build-up in eastern waters
limitations: naval strategic lens

title: Destroying all Rivals, 1803–1811
scope: capture of key Indian Ocean positions, French threat and British strategic system before 1815
limitations: maritime military lens; does not explain Kandyan internal politics

title: The Company Reduced, its Empire Expanded, 1811–1838
scope: post-1815 relaxation of naval establishment after removal of French threat
limitations: naval posture is contextual, not a direct cause of Kandyan annexation

title: The antiquity of Jaffna Fort: new evidence from post-disaster archaeological investigations in northern Sri Lanka
scope: pre-colonial Jaffna trade layers beneath colonial fortifications
limitations: mixed early deposits and provisional dating require caution

title: Dutch Forts exhibition panels photographed at Jaffna Fort
scope: fort chain, alliance, trade, Mannar labour/economy
limitations: field mediation; underlying curated exhibition separately registered

title: Jaffna Fort Post Disaster Archaeological Research Project panel
scope: field interpretation of post-conflict conservation and buried pre-European layers
limitations: public panel; causal and dating claims cross-checked with Antiquity 2019
